panels.title: Salud de la batería
panels.description: Capacidad actual / capacidad de referencia. La referencia es el valor de 'Capacidad de referencia' de arriba o, si está vacío, el percentil 95 de todas las estimaciones. La línea dentro del indicador es todo el historial de ese valor. La capacidad se estima al final de cada carga que haya añadido al menos 100 unidades de autonomía nominal: autonomía nominal x eficiencia / nivel de batería utilizable.

targets.rawSql:
WITH eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
cap AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.end_date AS t, pos.odometer::float8 AS odo,
               (c.rated_battery_range_km * eff.e * 100.0
                 / c.usable_battery_level)::float8 AS cap
        FROM charging_processes cp
        CROSS JOIN eff
        JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT rated_battery_range_km, usable_battery_level FROM charges
          WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id AND usable_battery_level > 0
            AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true
        LEFT JOIN positions pos ON pos.id = cp.position_id
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added >= eff.e * 100),
capref AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(
          NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('$reference_kwh'), ''), '0')::float8,
          (SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) FROM cap)
        ) AS ref,
        NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('$reference_kwh'), ''), '0') IS NOT NULL
          AS manual)
SELECT s.t AS time, r.med * 100 / NULLIF((SELECT ref FROM capref), 0) AS health
FROM cap s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) AS med
  FROM (SELECT cap FROM cap c2 WHERE c2.t <= s.t
        ORDER BY c2.t DESC LIMIT 10) z) r
WHERE s.t <= ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Capacidad actual
panels.description: Mediana de las 10 estimaciones de capacidad más recientes. La capacidad se estima al final de cada carga que haya añadido al menos 100 unidades de autonomía nominal: autonomía nominal x eficiencia / nivel de batería utilizable.

targets.rawSql:
WITH periods AS (
        SELECT n, t0, t1 FROM (VALUES
          (1, ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - (($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')), ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
          (2, ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))) v(n, t0, t1)),
eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
cap AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.end_date AS t, pos.odometer::float8 AS odo,
               (c.rated_battery_range_km * eff.e * 100.0
                 / c.usable_battery_level)::float8 AS cap
        FROM charging_processes cp
        CROSS JOIN eff
        JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT rated_battery_range_km, usable_battery_level FROM charges
          WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id AND usable_battery_level > 0
            AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true
        LEFT JOIN positions pos ON pos.id = cp.position_id
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added >= eff.e * 100)
SELECT p.t1 AS time, m.* FROM periods p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) FROM (SELECT cap FROM cap WHERE t <= p.t1 ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 10) z) AS capacity) m ORDER BY p.n

panels.title: Capacidad perdida
panels.description: Capacidad de referencia menos capacidad actual. Las pequeñas oscilaciones negativas o positivas entre estaciones son normales.

          (2, ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))) v(n, t0, t1)),
eff AS (

            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95

            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id

cap AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.end_date AS t, pos.odometer::float8 AS odo,
               (c.rated_battery_range_km * eff.e * 100.0
                 / c.usable_battery_level)::float8 AS cap
        FROM charging_processes cp
        CROSS JOIN eff
        JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT rated_battery_range_km, usable_battery_level FROM charges
          WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id AND usable_battery_level > 0
            AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true
        LEFT JOIN positions pos ON pos.id = cp.position_id
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added >= eff.e * 100),
capref AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(
          NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('$reference_kwh'), ''), '0')::float8,
          (SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) FROM cap)
        ) AS ref,
        NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('$reference_kwh'), ''), '0') IS NOT NULL
          AS manual)
SELECT p.t1 AS time, m.* FROM periods p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT (SELECT ref FROM capref) - (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) FROM (SELECT cap FROM cap WHERE t <= p.t1 ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 10) z) AS lost) m ORDER BY p.n

panels.title: ¿Qué tan fiable es esto?
panels.description: Alta: 5 o más cargas válidas en los últimos 90 días y la más reciente tiene menos de 30 días. Media: 5 o más en total y la más reciente tiene menos de 90 días. Baja: cualquier caso inferior. Las cargas profundas (gran variación del nivel de batería) dan las mejores estimaciones.

targets.rawSql:
WITH eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
cap AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.end_date AS t, pos.odometer::float8 AS odo,
               (c.rated_battery_range_km * eff.e * 100.0
                 / c.usable_battery_level)::float8 AS cap
        FROM charging_processes cp
        CROSS JOIN eff
        JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT rated_battery_range_km, usable_battery_level FROM charges
          WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id AND usable_battery_level > 0
            AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true
        LEFT JOIN positions pos ON pos.id = cp.position_id
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added >= eff.e * 100)
SELECT CASE WHEN recent >= 5 AND age <= 30 THEN 3
            WHEN total >= 5 AND age <= 90 THEN 2
            WHEN total >= 1 THEN 1 END AS confidence
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
             COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '90 days') AS recent,
             EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - MAX(t))) / 86400 AS age
      FROM cap) x

panels.title: Capacidad a lo largo del tiempo
panels.description: Puntos: una estimación por cada carga válida. Línea azul: mediana de las últimas 10 estimaciones (la 'capacidad actual'). Banda gris: donde cae el 80% de esas últimas 10 estimaciones, así que una banda ancha significa una estimación con ruido. Línea discontinua: tendencia lineal sobre todo el historial. Los marcadores verticales son actualizaciones de software.

targets.rawSql:
WITH eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
cap AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.end_date AS t, pos.odometer::float8 AS odo,
               (c.rated_battery_range_km * eff.e * 100.0
                 / c.usable_battery_level)::float8 AS cap
        FROM charging_processes cp
        CROSS JOIN eff
        JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT rated_battery_range_km, usable_battery_level FROM charges
          WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id AND usable_battery_level > 0
            AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true
        LEFT JOIN positions pos ON pos.id = cp.position_id
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added >= eff.e * 100),
captrend AS (
        SELECT regr_slope(cap, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t) / 86400.0) AS per_day,
               regr_intercept(cap, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t) / 86400.0) AS at_zero,
               regr_slope(cap, odo) AS per_km, COUNT(*) AS n,
               MAX(t) AS last_t
        FROM cap)
SELECT s.t AS time, s.cap AS estimate, r.med AS median, r.lo, r.hi,
       CASE WHEN tr.n >= 5 THEN tr.at_zero
         + tr.per_day * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.t) / 86400 END AS trend
FROM cap s CROSS JOIN captrend tr 
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) AS med,
         percentile_cont(0.1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) AS lo,
         percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) AS hi
  FROM (SELECT cap FROM cap c2 WHERE c2.t <= s.t
        ORDER BY c2.t DESC LIMIT 10) z) r

WHERE $__timeFilter(s.t) ORDER BY 1
SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', 'Model', model, COALESCE(NULLIF(marketing_name, ''), trim_badging)) AS model FROM cars WHERE id = $car_id

panels.title: Uso desde el inicio del registro
panels.description: Cuatro datos sobre todo el historial registrado. Ciclos completos: toda la energía cargada dividida entre la capacidad actual. Autonomía nominal: lo que el coche mostraría hoy al 100%. Típico significa la mediana.

targets.rawSql:
WITH chg AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.start_date, cp.end_date, cp.geofence_id,
               cp.charge_energy_added::float8 AS added,
               GREATEST(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added)::float8
                 AS used,
               cp.cost::float8 AS cost, cp.duration_min,
               cp.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               cp.start_battery_level AS soc0, cp.end_battery_level AS soc1,
               COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.road, a.city, 'Desconocido') AS place,
               CASE WHEN k.is_dc THEN 'DC'
                    WHEN cp.geofence_id IN ($home) THEN 'Home'
                    ELSE 'Public AC' END AS kind
        FROM charging_processes cp
        LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
        LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(fast_charger_present), false) AS is_dc
          FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) k ON true
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0),
eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
cap AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.end_date AS t, pos.odometer::float8 AS odo,
               (c.rated_battery_range_km * eff.e * 100.0
                 / c.usable_battery_level)::float8 AS cap
        FROM charging_processes cp
        CROSS JOIN eff
        JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT rated_battery_range_km, usable_battery_level FROM charges
          WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id AND usable_battery_level > 0
            AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true
        LEFT JOIN positions pos ON pos.id = cp.position_id
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added >= eff.e * 100)
SELECT v.label, v.value FROM (VALUES
  (1, 'Ciclos de carga completos equivalentes',
     ((SELECT SUM(added) FROM chg) / NULLIF((SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) FROM (SELECT cap FROM cap WHERE t <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 10) z), 0))::float8),
  (2, 'Energía de carga rápida DC (%)',
     (SELECT SUM(added) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'DC') * 100
        / NULLIF(SUM(added), 0) FROM chg)::float8),
  (3, 'Nivel típico al terminar una carga (%)',
     (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY soc1)
        FROM chg)::float8),
  (4, 'Autonomía nominal al 100% ($length_unit)',
     convert_km(((SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) FROM (SELECT cap FROM cap WHERE t <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 10) z) / (SELECT e FROM eff))::numeric, '$length_unit')::float8)) v(o, label, value)
ORDER BY v.o
